## 2026-11-23

### Impact

- **Transact can show Portuguese and regional text.** Apps can pass a locale code such as `pt-BR` or `en_CA` in `Config.language`, and the SDK sends Transact one of its supported locales (en-US, en-CA, es-US, fr-CA, pt-BR). A bare language such as `en` takes its region from the device, so existing integrations can get regional text without code changes. Wrappers that pass a config token get the same behavior.
- **Code that treats `Config.Language` as an enum needs a small update.** It is now a class. `Config.Language.en`, `.es`, `.fr` and `valueOf(String)` keep their signatures, so most integrations compile unchanged. `values()`, `entries`, `name` and exhaustive `when` over it no longer compile. `valueOf` now accepts any locale code instead of throwing on unknown values.

### Changes

- Added public Kotlin models for Payments Hub accounts, companies, suggestions and actions in `financial.atomic.transact.api`
- Added `TransactSession.apiClient` to read Payments Hub data, search companies and execute actions without presenting Transact
- Added Portuguese and full locale codes to `Config.language`, resolved to the locales Transact supports. `Config.Language` is now a class instead of an enum
- Added `Config.Platform.hostFramework` for wrapper SDKs, reported the wrapper version in telemetry, and reported React Native and Capacitor token sessions under their own platform instead of native. `Platform`'s constructor and `copy` gain the parameter, and `encode()` now returns `Map<String, Any?>`

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name              | Compatible | Build Version |
| ----------------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin            | 2.1+       | 2.2.21        |
| Gradle            | 8.11.1+    | 8.14.2        |
| AGP               | 8.9.1+     | 8.13.2        |
| Compile SDK       | 36+        | 36            |
| Min SDK           | 23         | 23            |
| Tested Target SDK | 36         | 36            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name              | Compatible | Build Version |
| ----------------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin            | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle            | 8.7+       | 8.14.2        |
| AGP               | 8.6+       | 8.6.1         |
| Compile SDK       | 35+        | 35            |
| Min SDK           | 23         | 23            |
| Tested Target SDK | 36         | 36            |

JetBrains tests Kotlin 1.9.x only through AGP 8.1, so the Kotlin Gradle plugin warns that AGP 8.6+ is above its tested range. The warning is expected. The build works, and CI verifies the legacy artifact against it.
